summary.value: Pod Times Square, at 400 W 42nd St, is a compact, budget-smart hotel guests love for its location and helpful desk team, including free luggage storage. Rooms are tight and a nightly fee lifts the real price, so it suits travelers out all day.

description.value: Pod Times Square is an affordable Midtown NYC hotel with smart rooms, free Wi-Fi, walking tours and a prime location near Broadway, at 400 W 42nd St on the far west side of Times Square. Guests write The location is fantastic! and The room was cleaned daily at 10 AM and was very tidy, and the front desk wins praise for luggage storage and a lounge for waiting. Watch-outs: The room was a little small, and there's a nightly resort fee of $29.84 collected at the front desk.

itineraryNote: Pod Times Square: smart, small rooms at 400 W 42nd St with helpful staff; save on the room and spend on Broadway.
review1: Pod Times Square's location just off the theater district is repeatedly called fantastic, putting shows, restaurants and the subway within an easy walk.
review2: The front desk earns praise for friendly help, free luggage storage and a comfortable lounge area for guests waiting to check in or leave.
review3: Guests warn about a nightly resort-style fee collected at check-in, so the real nightly cost is higher than the headline price suggests.
review4: As the brand name implies, rooms are compact, and guests recommend packing light and treating the room mainly as a place to sleep.
